query:
SELECT p.id, p.packageCode, p.trackingNumber, p.status, c.fullName, c.email 
FROM packages p 
JOIN customers c ON p.customerId = c.id 
WHERE c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email != '' 
LIMIT 10;
